messages:
Zara: Quick callout — I'm volunteering at the neighborhood library's tech tutoring drop-in on Sat 9:30-11. Kids+elders, basic email and resume help. Anyone want to join?
Eli: Super down. I can bring an old Chromebook and some sticky notes.
Diego: Im in for 10-11. Cant do the whole time.
Priya: Love that. Ill swing by after my yoga class (prob around 10:40). Need anything specific?
Zara: Extra power strips and patient explanations of copy/paste help a lot :grin:
Eli: Ill bring a small power strip and a bag of USB-C cables.
Diego: Heads up — I may need to duck out if client ping comes in, but Ill stay as long as I can.
Zara: No worries. Even 20 mins helps. Also planning a backyard movie night Sun 7pm if folks want low-key hang. BYO blanket/snack.
Priya: Movie night!! Whats the film?
Zara: Thinking either a goofy sci-fi (The Iron Giant vibe) or a mellow indie. Vote with :popcorn: for sci-fi or :tea: for indie.
Eli: :popcorn: — Im bringing a projector and an HDMI adapter.
Diego: :tea: — leaning chill. Also can bring fairy lights.
Priya: :tea: — could bring one of my playlists for pre-show tunes.
Ops-bot: Reminder: please follow noise curfew rules for our block. Quiet hours start at 10:30pm.
Zara: Good point. Well keep volume down after 10 and move to porch chatter if people stay.
Eli: RSVP: library tutoring Sat 9:30-11 (Eli full), movie night Sun 7 (Eli yes).
Diego: RSVP: library 10-11 (Diego maybe earlier), movie night yes (will bring lights).
Priya: RSVP: library maybe 10:40+, movie night yes (playlist + chamomile tea).
Zara: Thanks all — Ill DM the library lead and post exact address for the movie night tomorrow. If anyone wants to carpool to the library ping me.
